export_policy: Original/replay perf.data files, executable bytes, fixture data and large per-frame classified JSON are retained locally and omitted. Export includes raw decoded IP stacks, exact scripts/commands, replay hashes/patch records, classification summaries, runtime identities and checked logs. Captured absolute paths preserve cache provenance.
audit_limits: Portable verify.py recomputes decoded ancestry weights and checks recorded loss/IP-validation facts. Without original perf.data or ELF bytes it cannot independently revalidate CFI, sample payload preservation, executable identity or raw-to-decoded matching. Those were checked locally and independently reviewed. Binary symbol ranges and load biases are recorded inputs.
measurement_limits: Three diagnostic captures per condition, not a speedup experiment. Planning ancestry is an inclusive sampled lower bound under finite-stack truncation. Do not pool CPU sampling fractions with PGSS elapsed fractions or compute phase microseconds per operation from whole-client operation counts. Replay-generated symbol labels are shifted; only raw IPs resolved through original maps and original ELF are used.
